title: Lulu and the Little Boat | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Lulu has a little toy boat with a white sail. She puts it on the pond and blows: puff, puff!
The boat sails far away and stops. Frog hops onto his lily pad and gives it a little push.
The boat comes back, thank you, Frog! The sun goes down and the friends sleep by the pond.
A calm bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
